column1: # Dynamic multi-boot: otaupd is the only reserved secondary app slot.
# Installations occupy aligned gaps from 0x920000 to 0xf20000.
# otaupd (ota_0) is update scratch for the WiFi/RPC updater
# the dual-boot pool therefore starts at ota_1. Keep this table and
# components/multiboot/layout.c in sync - the recovery bootloader memcmp's them.
# Bootloader recovery uses partbackup if a table update is interrupted.
